qwen_instruction: Map Japanese human motion descriptions into a semantic space for full-body motion generation.

notes: The promoted-anchor gate runs in preserved v3 Qwen space before specialist routing; when it fires, the promoted-anchor residual is used and specialist residuals are bypassed.
The promoted-anchor gate was validated at threshold 0.8 with 100/100 anchor examples detected and 0/6743 existing examples falsely detected.
Residual adapters are applied only when the router selects a specialist domain at or above the confidence threshold and the promoted-anchor gate does not fire.
Generic prompts that do not trigger the promoted-anchor gate retain the preserved v3 base path exactly.

An explicit motion category hint restricts semantic-neighbor lookup to reviewed concepts in that category; if similarity is at least 0.82, the nearest concept contributes a 0.20 blend in v3 Qwen space. Auto mode performs no category blend.
dynamic_cute_dance and multi-stage runway prompts remain single-VAC requests; exact temporal ordering is treated as a capability limitation rather than split into multiple clips.
Fine finger shapes such as peace signs and finger hearts remain Hand Layer responsibilities.
